services.name: Cold Plunge Immersion
services.desc: Cold plunge therapy - also known as cold water immersion - involves submerging your body in water around 50°F (10°C) for short periods. While it may sound intense, this practice has been used for centuries for its powerful recovery and immune-boosting benefits. Cold exposure triggers your blood vessels to constrict and then expand once you warm back up. This flushing effect helps reduce inflammation, clear metabolic waste, and accelerate muscle recovery. Regular cold plunges can also stimulate endorphins, the body’s natural “feel-good” chemicals, leaving you feeling calm yet energized.
